description: This file defines the CommentsController class for handling HTTP requests related to comments in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes actions for creating, retrieving, and deleting comments associated with articles, utilizing MediatR for command and query dispatching.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core controller handling comment-related endpoints. Uses dependency injection for IMediator to dispatch commands and queries.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment on an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve list of comments for an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a comment by ID from an article identified by slug.
